entities.description: A tall, slender white flagpole stands vertically against a clear blue sky, topped with a spherical finial. A portion of a blue flag is visible attached to the right side of the pole, partially unfurled.

A close-up, eye-level shot of a white marble statue of a young male figure wearing a laurel wreath and draped in a toga with a breastplate, holding a scroll in each hand. The statue has a serene expression and is set against a blurred background featuring a French flag and a classical building facade.

clothing.toga: draped over left shoulder and across body

attributes.expression: serene, looking slightly to the right
